limitations: Six cases do not qualify the thirty-case gate
Reassessments are unchanged-output regrading, not new model trials
Single real retry diagnostic executed no tools and does not prove task success
Concurrent jobs do not qualify cache, cost or latency attribution
Runtime snapshots retain historical external workspace dependency symlinks; complete dependency attribution remains open
No policy was promoted to default
Second batch froze currency/record/cursor grader corrections before the final calculation-line correction; regrading is reported separately
Supplemental report raw baseline failure is a formatting false negative; final regrading is 3/3 vs 3/3 and is not another real-model comparison
Numeric report grading does not validate arbitrary prose annotations
Latest fresh case set selects both entire report arms after the grader correction; original full batches and their regressed gates remain retained
